data.one_liner: Cached network images with built-in shimmer loading and profile initials support.
data.what_it_does: Display network images with caching, animated shimmer placeholders, fallback error states, retry handling, and optional profile initials generation.
use_when: You need to display cached network images with shimmer loading placeholders.
You want automatic fallback handling for invalid URLs and failed requests.
You need to display user profile initials when a profile picture is missing.
avoid_when: You need complex image manipulation or editing features.
You are not loading images over the network.
strengths: Includes built-in shimmer loading and fallback error handling.
Supports profile initials and circular avatar constructors.
Provides memory optimization and retry support out of the box.
weaknesses: Relies on specific third-party image caching and shimmer implementations.
Limited to predefined loading styles and widget layouts.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard, highly customizable core caching library without pre-bundled shimmer widgets and profile initials logic.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a composable image building system with customizable error, placeholder, and image builders.

data.minimal_example:
CustomCachedImage(
  imageUrl: 'https://example.com/sample.jpg',
  width: 150,
  height: 150,
  borderRadius: 10,
  fit: BoxFit.cover,
)
